verdict.rationale: Heap's pricing page lists "Data warehouse integration" as a feature of a higher plan, so the product claims some first-party warehouse connectivity. Nothing describes how it works: no direction, no continuous event export, no in-product querying of warehouse tables. CSV exports and the bulk track API are one-off or inbound mechanisms and do not count as warehouse sync. Missing for 10: documentation of continuous event export to a warehouse, in-product querying of warehouse tables, supported warehouses and sync cadence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sync events between the platform and my own data warehouse (query warehouse tables in-product or export events continuously to it)
